title: Balance gallery preview levels with bounded on-demand measurements
description: Implement an optional approximate RMS preview-level comparison using one short offline measurement per played candidate, attenuate only before the shared final limiter, retain direct unbalanced comparison, and verify signal spread, cancellation, caching and output bounds. This is a small fairness proof, not perceived-loudness equivalence or full archived replay.
close_reason: Implemented optional attenuate-only RMS balancing, lazy 16-second measurement/cache, original-level comparison and cancellation-safe playback. Native six-candidate check reduced RMS spread 1.63x to 1.03x; final limiter remains on every audible path. 30 unit tests and both Playwright suites passed.

title: EVO-05 — Fair and reproducible comparisons
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-05 — Fair and reproducible comparisons

- [ ] Keep passage, seed, musical starting state, narrative target and non-evolved settings consistent across candidates.
- [ ] Compare similar phrase-length excerpts; test whether sequential playback or switching at a shared musical position is easier to judge.
- [ ] Check loudness bias between variants. The output cap bounds samples but does not establish equal perceived loudness.
- [ ] Record full generation lineage: parents, all candidates, selected/rejected/skipped items, mutation settings, versions and preview context. Current history stores A/B decisions and only the latest 80.
- [ ] Add reliable replay of an archived comparison, with clear handling of incompatible composer/content/genome versions. Symbolic replay does not promise identical DSP samples across browsers.
notes: Completed child awen-3fr.5.1: on-demand approximate RMS balancing attenuates only, with cache/cancellation checks and unchanged output cap. In a small six-candidate native render, raw highest/lowest RMS 1.63 became 1.03 at reference volume. This does not establish equal perceived loudness. Gallery context is fixed and accepted choices retain selected-preview gain metadata. Remaining: listening evaluation of loudness/switching, full generation-lineage/archive decisions and compatible archived replay. No large corpus or pre-rendered library added.

title: EVO-04 — Taste, narrative fit and reading comfort
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-04 — Taste, narrative fit and reading comfort

- [ ] Distinguish I enjoy this, It fits this passage and It helps me read. Do not treat them as the same judgement.
- [ ] Add optional quick feedback: too busy, too plonky, too droney, too tense. Keep these separate from candidate selection.

title: EVO-03 — Richer musical traits
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-03 — Richer musical traits

- [ ] Evaluate traits for melodic rest frequency/length, motif spacing, harmonic change rate, register, orchestration and scene persistence.
- [ ] Improve foreground/background interaction so more continuous music can still breathe without returning to an unchanging drone.
- [ ] Define perceptually useful bounds and test extremes/combinations. Preserve coherent harmony, scheduling, polyphony and output limiting.
- [ ] Audit the current six traits for audible range and interactions, including whether activity increases/decreases are equally useful.

Acceptance: different genomes produce clearly different musical behaviours, while every candidate remains a plausible reading accompaniment.

title: EVO-02 — Explore nearby or explore widely
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-02 — Explore nearby or explore widely

- [ ] Add a mutation-strength control: small refinements versus broader exploration.
- [ ] Start each batch with the unchanged parent, a few nearby variants and at least one more distant but musically constrained option.
- [ ] Prevent duplicate/nearly identical candidates; vary audible characteristics rather than only changing seed labels.
- [ ] Define compatible recombination for multiple selected parents. Preserve authored harmonic/phrase constraints and output limits.
- [ ] Separate a composition seed from a personal preference genome and a palette identifier. Record all three.
- [ ] Keep the existing foreground/background scope; consider locking any trait the listener already likes.

Acceptance: repeated selection can refine a favourite, while broad exploration can escape an unhelpful starting point.
notes: Nearby/wide controls, scoped multi-parent recombination, unchanged parent plus pins, minimum parameter-distance checks, and a further-afield candidate are implemented as part of the gallery proof. New candidates always alter melody or background presence to avoid only subtle filter/room changes. Composition seed, palette and genome remain separate and are recorded with adopted choices.
close_reason: Implemented nearby/wide scoped multi-parent evolution, distinct bounded candidates, preserved parent/pins and a further-afield option. Validated 28 unit tests and native six-candidate Playwright audio/UI proof. Perceptual quality remains a human listening gate.

title: EVO-01 — A gallery with a wider choice
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-01 — A gallery with a wider choice

- [ ] Replace or supplement the two-option comparison with an initial gallery of **six candidates**, including the current favourite. Six is a starting design choice to test, not a research result.
- [ ] Use clearly labelled cards with Play/Stop, Keep favourite, Pin and Explore from here. Play only one candidate at a time through the existing limited output graph.
- [ ] Offer a few optional plain descriptions such as warmer, more space or more movement. Generate descriptions from actual parameter differences; do not imply the system heard or understood the music.
- [ ] Allow one favourite or several selected parents; offer None of these and New batch without forcing a ranking of every candidate.
- [ ] Preserve pinned favourites between rounds. Let the listener replay the parent and undo a generation.
- [ ] Keep previewing optional and separate from ordinary reading. Restore the reading position and original score cursor when leaving the gallery.
- [ ] Test keyboard access, touch layout, accessible playing/selected states and the time burden of listening to six options.

Acceptance: a listener can hear a meaningfully wider range, choose one or more promising directions and generate a new round without losing favourites or their reading place.
notes: Implemented six-card accessible dialog with 16-second previews, one persistent limited audio graph, pin/unpin (three saved favourites), multi-parent exploration, skip/new batch, eight-batch undo, restore/cancel, and bounded profile migration. Automated tests cover keyboard, mobile, persistence and native signal variation. Listening usefulness and the 96-second upper bound for six full previews still need a short human trial; no dataset or cloud processing added.
close_reason: Implemented and validated gallery proof; 28 unit tests and real Playwright gallery checks pass. Human listening quality remains an explicitly separate evaluation task.
